cohort: 60 patients (ASA I-II, 30-60 years old) undergoing laparoscopic-assisted vaginal hysterectomy
finding: Dexmedetomidine, used as an adjuvant to local anesthesia, significantly prolonged post-operative analgesia and facilitated early ambulation compared to fentanyl in patients undergoing laparoscopic-assisted vaginal hysterectomy.
